description: Page header with title, description, path and contextual actions.

howToUse: Use it at the top of each page: the title, a line that says what the page is for, and the main actions.
The `title` becomes the page's only `<h1>`. Put the description in `lead` and the actions in `actions`, with at most one primary.
Pass a Breadcrumb in `breadcrumb` on deep pages, and context in `eyebrow` ("Team · Settings").
alternatives: A section inside the page: SectionHeader.
The opening of a public site: Hero.

keyboard.action: Moves through the path and the actions. The title does not receive focus.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono uppercase eyebrow above the title (e.g. "Workspace · Example Team").

props.name: title
props.description: Page title (becomes the `<h1>`; only one per page).

props.name: lead
props.description: Lead/description under the title (max 62ch, secondary color).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right (`Button`/`SplitButton`), aligned to the bottom of the text block.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Trail slot above the eyebrow: pass the `Breadcrumb` atom. A breadcrumb always leads back to the parent.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
